visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a scallion pancake being flipped on a hot, oily metal griddle using a large metal spatula. The surface of the dough is golden-brown and bubbling with oil. (2) A person's hands are seen on a floured wooden surface using a wooden rolling pin to flatten a dough ball filled with vibrant green scallions. (3) On the hot griddle, two spatulas are used to vigorously tear and fluff the pancake, creating light, flaky layers as steam rises. (4) A metal seasoning shaker dispenses a fine powder over a finished, golden-brown pancake resting on a dark wooden board. (5) A large metal cleaver slices the pancake into triangles with rapid, precise movements. (6) Close-up shots showcase a paper bag containing multiple layers of sliced pancake, followed by an extreme close-up of a leek pocket filled with green leeks and clear vermicelli. (7) A pork pie is broken open to reveal a steaming meat filling with visible juices. (8) The camera pans to show the exterior of a small street-side stall where two male staff members wearing dark shirts and aprons work behind a glass-covered counter. The setting is a narrow urban alleyway with parked scooters and bright daytime lighting.
